name: PALLADIUM ONE MINING INC
summary: Palladium One Mining Inc. is a Canadian mineral exploration and development company focused on platinum group elements (PGE), nickel, copper, and gold deposits in established mining districts. The company's flagship asset is the Läntinen Koillismaa (LK) project in north-central Finland. They are focused on developing a large-scale, low-cost PGE-nickel-copper project.
